ocl:
context LibraryAccount
inv: (self.student.program.durationYears <= 50) and (self.accountId.size() >= 9 implies self.accountId.substring(1, 9) = 'AB')

context Instructor
inv: (self.department.faculty.name <> '') and (self.email.size() >= 4 implies self.email.substring(1, 4) = 'AB')

context Scholarship
inv: (if self.startYear > self.endYear then self.startYear else self.endYear endif > 11) and (self.endYear mod 2 = 1)

context CourseOffering
inv: self.capacity >= 2 and self.capacity <= 65

context Semester
inv: self.endDate <> null and self.startDate <> null

context Scholarship
inv: self.startYear <> null and self.endYear <> null

context Scholarship
inv: self.endYear <> null implies self.startYear <> null

context Semester
inv: self.startDate <> null and self.endDate <> null

context Scholarship
inv: self.startYear <> null implies self.endYear <> null

context Scholarship
inv: self.endYear <> null and self.startYear <> null

context CourseOffering
inv: (self.enrollments->any(x | x.enrolledAt <> '') <> null) and (self.instructor.oclIsTypeOf(Instructor))

context Scholarship
inv: (self.endYear + self.startYear > 73) and (self.endYear + self.startYear > 64)

context Scholarship
inv: (self.endYear + self.startYear > 71) and (not(self.endYear + self.startYear > 71))

context GradeRecord
inv: ((self.enrollment.student.yearOfStudy >= 2) and (self.letterGrade <> null)) and (self.enrollment.student.yearOfStudy < 2)

context Building
inv: (self.rooms->exists(x | x.capacity <= 1000)) and (not(self.rooms->exists(x | x.capacity <= 1000)))

context Enrollment
inv: (self.grade <> null) and (not(self.grade <> null))

context CourseOffering
inv: ((self.enrollments->size() > 0) and (self.room <> null)) and (self.enrollments->size() < -5)

context Building
inv: (self.rooms->select(x | x.capacity > 10)->size() >= 1) and (not(self.rooms->select(x | x.capacity > 10)->size() >= 1))

context Course
inv: ((self.credits <= 1000) and (self.offerings->forAll(v | v.capacity < 50))) and (self.credits > 1000)

context Department
inv: (self.instructors->collect(x | x.offerings)->flatten()->notEmpty()) and (not(self.instructors->collect(x | x.offerings)->flatten()->notEmpty()))

context CourseOffering
inv: ((self.capacity > 10) and (self.enrollments->forAll(v | v.enrolledAt <> ''))) and (self.capacity < 5)

context Exam
inv: (((self.attempts->one(x | x.marks > 2)) and (self.offering.oclIsTypeOf(CourseOffering))) and (self.attempts->size() = 2)) and (not(((self.attempts->one(x | x.marks > 2)) and (self.offering.oclIsTypeOf(CourseOffering))) and (self.attempts->size() = 2)))

context University
inv: (self.buildings->forAll(x | x.code <> '')) and (self.buildings->exists(x | not(x.code <> '')))

context Room
inv: ((self.building.university.name <> '') and (self.capacity mod 2 = 0)) and (not((self.building.university.name <> '') and (self.capacity mod 2 = 0)))

context CourseOffering
inv: (self.exams->size() >= 2 and self.exams->size() <= 2) and (self.exams->size() < 2)
